name: R1
summary: A small full-body humanoid Unitree launched from about US$5,900 — the lowest advertised price for a walking humanoid to date — undercutting even its own G1. Aimed at developers and education, it continues Unitree's strategy of driving the price floor of the category down aggressively.
notable: Cheapest walking humanoid on the market at launch (~US$5,900)
